title: HandoffRecommendation

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accountId.description: The account to hand the work to: the one with the most room; null with no-target.

reason.description: Why the recommendation is what it is: limit-reached (the account handed from has a window the provider is refusing, and accountId has room), limit-near (it has met a hand-off threshold, and accountId has room), most-room (accountId has the most room, and the account handed from, if any, has met no threshold), or no-target (accountId is null: fewer accounts were ranked than make a choice, two when no account is handed from and one other when one is, or none ranked has room to take the work, since a full or refused account is never named).

message.description: The recommendation in a sentence, the same in every client.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

fromAccountId.description: The account the work is handed from, as asked; null when the question was only which account has the most room.

threshold.description: The threshold's key: five_hour, seven_day, fable.

label.description: The window as a sentence names it: 5-hour, weekly, Fable.

at.description: The utilisation, 0 to 1, at or above which the work should be handed on.

window.description: The account's window that met it.

utilisation.description: The window's utilisation, rounded to a whole percent; 1 for a refused window that reported none.

anyOf.description: The latest rate-limit verdict a run of the account reported for the window (plan.limit): allowed, warning (near the limit) or rejected (refused until the reset, whatever the utilisation reads).

verdict.description: The window's verdict: rejected when the provider is refusing, whatever the threshold.

anyOf.description: The hand-off threshold the account handed from has met: which, on what window, and how full it reads.

trigger.description: The threshold the account handed from has met; null when it has met none, or none was named.

headroom.description: The recommended account's room in its tightest window: 1 less that window's utilisation, so at most 1, and above 0 for any account recommended (a provider may report utilisation beyond 1, which leaves an account below 0 and never recommended); null with no recommendation.

binding.description: The recommended account's tightest window, the one that sets its room; null with no recommendation.

candidates.description: How many accounts were ranked, the ones the recommendation was chosen from: the signed-in accounts (the account handed from aside) with plan limits and a reading under six minutes old by its newest observation with a usable number, a full or refused one among them though never named; an account never read, unavailable, stale, or whose windows have all rolled over is not counted.

anyOf.description: What the ranking compared: same-plan (every candidate is on one plan, so the shares describe one ceiling), weighted (the plans differ and each publishes its size against its provider's baseline), or percentage (shares of plans that cannot be compared by size; a client says so rather than claim capacity).

basis.description: What the ranking compared; null with no recommendation.

description: The hand-off recommendation, answered from the environment's cached readings so every client asking shows the same offer: the account with the most room, or none, why, and the threshold the account handed from has met.
